data.narrative:
Scout AI is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Colby Adcock and Collin Otis that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in Defense & Security, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses the $15M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $38M. Peer-Median triangulation across three same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A)—produces a median implied valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range of $32M to $460M, with a median of $219M. The disparity reflects material uncertainty regarding which comp set most accurately reflects Scout AI's competitive positioning and growth trajectory within the Defense & Security sector. Stage-Progression suggests a conservative floor, while Peer-Median implies meaningfully higher value, contingent on Scout AI's technical differentiation and market traction relative to the identified peer group. Further diligence on revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and go-to-market validation would be necessary to narrow this range.
